member.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class with a specified error message and a reference to the inner exception that is the cause of this exception.
member.param: The error message that explains the reason for the exception. This message should provide a clear and concise description of the error that occurred.

The exception that is the cause of the current exception. This parameter allows for the chaining of exceptions, providing a more detailed context for the error. If the parameter is not null, the current exception is raised in a catch block that handles the inner exception.
member.remarks:
This constructor enhances error handling by allowing developers to specify both a custom error message and the underlying exception that led to the error. This can be particularly helpful for debugging and logging purposes, as it provides a more comprehensive view of the error scenario.
Use this constructor when you catch an exception that you cannot handle and you want to wrap it in a to provide additional context or to categorize it as a scripting-related error within the GrapeCity ActiveReports system.
